messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for router-service in eu-west-1 — SLO breach (p99 > 1200ms) · auto-escalation to on-call :rotating_light:

 taylor: acked — I'm oncall. pulling graphs now. which customers are seeing errors?

 sam: seeing streaming stalls on a subset of requests, p95 ~ 320ms but p99 jumps to 1.3s. spikes correlate with routes tagged `blue-weighted`.

 priya: confirmed packet — chart: https://dash.internal/r/routers?range=15m&filter=eu-west-1 shows sudden tail at 12:10 UTC, concurrent increase in queue depth on lb-proxy-3.

 taylor: timeline: 12:05 small routing policy rollout (weight bump for model-variants to prefer local eu nodes). 12:09 first latency alerts. could be rollout bug.

 alex: logs from router show repeated `route-mismatch` entries:
```
2026-03-15T12:08:59Z router[pid=7]: route_decision: wanted shard=sh-42 region=eu1 but routed -> pod=eu2-19 (incompatible weight)
2026-03-15T12:09:00Z router[pid=7]: kvcache miss for session=abc123
```

 sam: also seeing hot partitioning on shard sh-42 — single backend getting >70% of traffic; connection queueing leads to tail.

 priya: customer impact: degraded streaming only for eu-west queueing customers; non-streaming gen still ok. PX score shows 14% of sessions had >1s tail. Reach out to top affected customers?

 taylor: set severity to P1 (SLO breach with partial customer impact). Paging: escalate to eng-runtime and oncall infra. @alex @priya please join bridge.

 maria: joining bridge — started packet capture on lb-proxy-3 and router-controllers. quick note: other regions stable. this looks routing-policy/regroup related.

 ops-runner: runbook suggests immediate mitigation: 1) pause routing rollout 2) scale dedicated pool for eu-west 3) add temporary sticky-affinity to spread keys.

 taylor: executing step 1: `k8s patch configmap router-policy --type merge -p '{"spec":{"rollout": "paused"}}'` — paused at 12:14 UTC.

 alex: pause confirmed. traffic still heavy to sh-42 though — seems cached decisions persisted at agents. kv-cache TTL is 30s, so will take a bit.

 sam: executing step 2 — scaling pool: `autoscale set eu-west-dedicated --replicas 6` (was 3).

 priya: scale hit at 12:16, new workers registered. tail reduced a bit but p99 still ~900ms.

 maria: found a policy bug in the rollout code — weights assigned using integer truncation, causing a handful of partitions to get disproportionate weight when variant weights were small. patch in PR #4122.

 alex: suggestion: revert to previous policy version to immediately restore balanced distribution.

 taylor: initiating rollback: `routerctl deploy-policy --env eu-west-1 --version v2026.03.14` at 12:18.

 incident-bot: DEPLOYMENT ROLLBACK STARTED — task id rb-9987 (initiated by taylor)

 sam: after rollback p99 down to 320ms within 2 minutes. streaming stalls cleared for most flows. queue depth normalized.

 priya: customer notes: notified SRE-runbook customers via status page and support flagged high-priority tickets for top 5 enterprise customers in eu-west.

 maria: root cause hypothesis: routing rollout logic integer-truncated fractional weights causing hot partition amplification combined with existing hotspot on sh-42. repro on staging with mix weights.

 alex: postmortem action items: 1) add unit tests for fractional weight logic 2) change weight datatype to fixed-point (Q16) 3) reduce default kv-cache TTL to 10s for policy rollouts 4) add canary traffic partition check before rollout 5) alert rule for per-shard skew > 3x baseline.

 taylor: handover: sam will be on follow-up for the next 4 hours, priya will own customer comms, alex/maria to own the fix. I'll update incident board and set status to 'mitigated' once p99 stable for 30m.

 sam: I'm leaving bridge, switching to post-incident scrub. ping me if any regression. :thumbsup:

 priya: drafted status update for customers and ops: ``We experienced elevated tail latency in eu-west-1 between 12:09-12:22 UTC caused by a routing policy rollout. We have rolled back the policy and scaled capacity. We're investigating root cause and will share postmortem.``

 incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED — p99 back under SLO (reported at 12:26 UTC). Closing on-call bridge in 10m unless further regressions.

 taylor: last checks: p95 210ms, p99 280ms, no new errors. closing bridge now. thanks all.

 alex: leaving notes: PR #4122 opened for the weight fix, test coverage + staging rollout scheduled.

 priya: assigning follow-ups in Jira: INF-7891 (postmortem), INF-7892 (customer comms), INF-7893 (config change + tests).

 maria: small ask — add dashboard widget for per-shard p99 and routing-policy version correlation. will help future live triage.

 taylor: agreed. adding to action item list.

 incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED: 30 participants notified via summary (auto).
